description: The tourist looks along the waterfront at blue hour, with pastel pink, ochre and sky-blue houses lining the quay to the right, their windows glowing. Fishing boats in blue and white bob in the glassy foreground water, throwing long amber reflections, while dark hills close the horizon to the left. The sky holds the last lavender-pink of dawn at 06:10, and the harbor lamps are still lit.
